class.name: RenderingSystem2D
class.brief_description: Optimized 2D canvas batcher for massive sprite populations.
class.description: [RenderingSystem2D] provides the 2D equivalent of the 3D rendering backend. It is optimized for "Bullet Hell" scenarios or massive 2D tile-based populations where [Node2D] overhead becomes a bottleneck. By using [method RenderingServer.canvas_item_add_multimesh], this system can draw tens of thousands of sprites (each with unique positions, rotations, and scales) in exactly [b]one GPU draw call[/b]. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike standard sprites, entities rendered through this system do not participate in Godot's Y-sorting or Z-index calculations automatically. They are drawn relative to the parent [CanvasItem] provided during initialization.

method.name: initialize_canvas_batching
method.description: Sets up the internal [MultiMesh2D] and attaches it to the specified [param parent_canvas]. All sprites managed by the ECS will share the provided [param texture] for batching efficiency.

method.name: process_render_updates
method.description: Pushes the latest [Transform2DComponent] data from the ECS into the canvas item's buffer.
